title: Don't Trust Barrels!
description: A hilarious and chaotic troll mod with 5 unique, trick barrels designed to prank your friends!
body:
# 📦 Don't Trust Barrels!

Think your items are safe? Think again! **Don't Trust Barrels!** is a hilarious and chaotic troll mod that introduces 5 unique, trick barrels designed to completely mess with anyone who dares to open them. Perfect for pranking your friends on multiplayer servers or custom maps!

---

## 🛑 Meet the Barrels

Here is the breakdown of all 5 custom troll barrels included in the mod:

### 🗑️ Trash Barrel
* **The Trap:** The ultimate item deleter.
* **How it works:** Put your precious diamonds, netherite, or gear inside, close the GUI, and *POOF!* Your items are permanently erased from existence! 

### 🔄 Stubborn Barrel
* **The Trap:** This barrel just refuses to hold anything.
* **How it works:** The moment you close the GUI, it forcefully spits everything back straight into your inventory! You can never empty your bags here.

### 💥 Scream Barrel
* **The Trap:** Hearts will stop!
* **How it works:** As soon as an unsuspecting player right-clicks to open this barrel, it plays a terrifying **Creeper hissing sound**. Watch your friends jump out of their chairs!

### 🏃‍♂️ Runaway Barrel
* **The Trap:** Good luck opening this one!
* **How it works:** The second you try to right-click it, the barrel instantly teleports to a random spot nearby. You'll literally have to chase your chest down!

### 💣 TNT Barrel
* **The Trap:** A ticking time bomb.
* **How it works:** If you open this barrel and keep the GUI open for just **1 second (20 ticks)**... *BOOM!* A massive explosion triggers right in your face!

---

## 🛠️ Features & Compatibility
* **Lightweight:** Super small file size (only ~300KB!) for fast loading.
* **Multiplayer Ready:** Fully functional in survival and perfect for messing with your friends.
* **Mod Loader:** Built for modern Minecraft versions using NeoForge.

*Created by **sidyasinX** using MCreator.*
